judgements.justification: A's Reviewer_3GRx proposed STOC/FOCS/COLT, Reviewer_AuTG called it 'somewhat niche' and A's area chair chose a poster for 'a handful of experts', all while calling the work strong; no B reviewer raised breadth or venue.
Both meta-reviews report their reviewers' positions and the rebuttal outcome accurately; B's area chair's slip concerns the paper's source of sample dependence, not the record.
Only two of A's four reviewers (3GRx, rK8U) left the rebuttal unanswered, and the reply on fit did not answer their points, so no revision was left undone.
The reviewer who did not verify the arguments, Reviewer_UuHj, sat on A, the lower-tier committee; B's thin Reviewer_91N9 claimed confidence 4 and did not say it could not verify the results.
Neither committee split between accept and reject; all eight scores are 6 or above.
The authors gave both committees the same answers on novelty, the replaceable Proposition 2.2 and other applications.
Reviewer_UuHj's wrong novelty account raised A, the lower committee, and Reviewer_91N9's 'first polynomial-time algorithm' is a summary paraphrase with no evident effect on B's tier.
B's spotlight follows its 7.25 mean, two 8s and a meta-review that praises the result; the tier has grounds in the record.
A's reservations concerned audience breadth and size of gain, not a neighbouring field's objection to the paper's framing or definitions.

B had Reviewer_48Ey's reasoned 8 at confidence 4 behind the paper; A's highest score was Reviewer_UuHj's unverified 7, who only acknowledged the rebuttal, and nobody in A argued against the niche view.
Both committees accepted the paper; no one judged the promised fixes too large for camera-ready.
Both area chairs relied on visible reviews (3GRx in A, 48Ey in B); no off-record input appears.
Both committees asked about other applications and both valued the theory as such; A's discount was audience fit, which R24 covers, not a contribution-type standard.
No reviewer on either committee held a below-threshold score after the rebuttal.
